verdict.rationale: Column is a developer banking API, and scheduled or rule-based payment automation is a fair capability for such a platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no user-configurable automations, scheduled or recurring transfers, or autonomous background jobs. Webhooks only notify you of events, so you would have to build any automation yourself, and auto-generated monthly statements are a built-in bank function rather than automations a user sets up.
